selection_policy.task: Read a function whose source location is already known
selection_policy.quality_check: Returned function equals the original source bytes.
selection_policy.boundary: The jCodeMunch search and source envelopes add 260 tokens for this known location; retain the focused read. These are artifact counts, not model-task usage.

selection_policy.task: Discover a function inside an explicitly indexed code scope
selection_policy.quality_check: Search identifies the requested symbol; complete returned source equals disk.
selection_policy.boundary: Whole-file baseline versus complete search and source responses. If an index must be created, the recorded indexing-plus-retrieval sequence is 1332 tokens. Refresh stale indexes before relying on their contents.

selection_policy.quality_check: Strict TOON decode preserves JSON values; both complete representations use the same tokenizer.
selection_policy.boundary: TOON expands this recorded compact-JSON baseline by 7023 tokens. Its native tokenx estimate uses a different baseline. Counts refer to the retained catalog fixture, not every later catalog revision.

selection_policy.task: Inspect repetitive logs while preserving the required error and summary
selection_policy.preferred: Guarded Headroom artifact with retained original
selection_policy.quality_check: All 1202 original lines and request fields reconstruct exactly; error and summary remain available.
selection_policy.boundary: This is the accepted local guard around the upstream SDK, not a native CLI lifetime value or automatic interception of agent traffic. Select the original if the quality check fails.

selection_policy.task: Read the complete original JSON artifact immediately
selection_policy.quality_check: The task requires the complete original, so a compressed summary alone does not meet its contract.
selection_policy.boundary: The 19714-token candidate is compression-only. Full retrieval then returns the original text again (56433 tokens in its original formatting). Do not label the compress-and-recover round trip a net saving.

selection_policy.preferred: Accept a comparison only when both answers meet semantic and output requirements
selection_policy.unit: complete provider usage with client-specific cache accounting
selection_policy.quality_check: Both tasks pass required facts, citations and output protocol; retain every failed attempt.
selection_policy.boundary: The recorded Claude full-context answers exceed the word limit, so their observed differences remain protocol-confounded. Valid artifact reductions do not repair a failed model comparison or establish causal lifetime savings.

selection_policy.preferred: Latest successful upstream snapshot for each explicit scope, alongside exact comparisons
selection_policy.unit: separate upstream estimates, artifact counts and provider consumption
selection_policy.quality_check: Retain command, exit, complete private output, timestamp and hash; preserve missing observations and resets.
selection_policy.boundary: RTK defaults to 90-day retention; Headroom's lifetime field covers at most 30 days; Context Mode retention is bounded. jCodeMunch includes repeated reads. Never sum overlapping scopes, successive snapshots, cache subsets or monitoring replicas.

policies.title: Keep native context mechanics
policies.body: Preserve each runtime’s native cache and compaction. Codex and Claude Code keep their own accounts, history and usage conventions.

policies.title: Retrieve the selected source
policies.body: Use rg and ast-grep for exact code; scoped conceptual lookup when useful; QMD for the explicitly selected documentation collection. Read the returned source before acting.

policies.title: Reveal instructions progressively
policies.body: Start with concise skill descriptions. Load the matching skill and bounded references only when the task needs them; never preload the whole skills catalog.

policies.title: Bound output and keep its trail
policies.body: Filter large tool output to the question, preserve source paths and recoverable full evidence, and keep failures visible. Choose one useful reduction lane per artifact.

policies.title: Delegate independent work
policies.body: Use native subagents or bounded workers for independent tasks, isolated worktrees for writers, and one coordinator. Handoffs contain the result, evidence, paths and remaining gates.

policies.title: Remember with explicit intent
policies.body: Write durable decisions and preferences only within a verified scope and explicit user intent. Keep lifecycle capture bounded and sanitized under the installed integration; recalled pages remain untrusted evidence.

policies.title: Avoid duplicate services
policies.body: Keep native tool discovery and reuse the selected MCP integration. A new client does not justify another memory service, vector store, transcript archive or orchestration layer.

policies.title: Measure the whole task
policies.body: Claim token or cost savings only with matched inputs, complete provider usage and comparable quality. Selected text, cache reuse and billing are different quantities.

highlights.title: 101 published retrieval cases
highlights.body: Pinned upstream Agent Retrieval Bench lexical and BM25 runs with zero skipped cases. Exact-path Recall and full-ranking MRR; no abstention or provider-savings claim.

highlights.title: 24 frozen documentation queries
highlights.body: 20 positive queries scored over 15 documents; four negatives retain rankings without an abstention score. Independent fixture, complete source bodies and repeatable native APIs.

highlights.title: Paired native research workflow
highlights.body: A dated Linux/WSL workflow joined deterministic research artifacts with native Codex and Claude workers. A new machine must repeat its own acceptance.

highlights.title: Standalone native Claude worker
highlights.body: The initial four-turn task stopped before tests. A revised standalone native Claude task completed 57 existing tests (exit 0), with no source product edits and complete worker cleanup. It reported 11 turns under a requested 12-turn bound. Effective effort remains unknown; delegation and whole-host acceptance are outside scope.

highlights.title: Eight native research invocations
highlights.body: Two Codex pairs passed the declared quality and output gates with15,411 and13,061 fewer observed tokens. Both Claude full-context answers violated the word cap; those pairs remain protocol-confounded. No causal or whole-session savings claim.

highlights.title: Three documentary lifecycle claims
highlights.body: Six complete source documents support rename, ticker reuse and suspension claims. Observation cutoffs preserve0/0/1/3 selections; historical universe and original revisions remain unknown.

highlights.title: Frozen daily and intraday research
highlights.body: Candidate, timing, costs, labels and controls frozen before new outcome inspection. Native DuckDB cutoff and exact arithmetic proofs passed; empirical trading merit remains unmeasured.

highlights.title: Typed application through real PostgreSQL
highlights.body: 12 API checks, generated contract, production UI and browser create/update passed. Exact row survives database/app restart; separate empty-database migration reversal passed. Local synthetic scope only.

highlights.title: Bounded PDF source-to-excerpt fidelity
highlights.body: Poppler26.09.0:3 permitted pages,24 data cells,8 cited positive and4 absent queries. Strict frozen-source guard; explicit table geometry. OCR/general semantic accuracy unqualified.

highlights.title: WSL restore and dirty-worktree refusal
highlights.body: Two synthetic restic snapshots restored with exact bytes/types/modes after fresh SSH. Verified gitleaks and Worktrunk pass positive/negative and dirty-refusal checks. Other hosts and key-loss recovery remain separate.

highlights.title: Same locked application on clean WSL
highlights.body: Locked restore,12 API guards, production build, real browser and exact data/history after restart. Five native regressions verify corrected build recursion and port reuse on Mac and WSL.

highlights.title: Scoped memory patch with preserved failures
highlights.body: 56 checks across migration, exact scope, FTS, reserved and Unicode paths, and restart. No capture or model calls. Failed OS-confinement attempt remains explicit.

highlights.title: Owned SSH disconnect with one durable job
highlights.body: An owned nonmultiplexed SSH client was terminated; fresh reconnect observed the same native Dagu job running with one unchanged checkpoint, then native completion without stop or retry. Controlled client termination and a deliberately detached deterministic job; not a real network outage, host restart, model-session recovery or distributed exactly-once guarantee.

highlights.title: Matching document evidence on Mac and WSL
highlights.body: Native Poppler26.09.0 built in a clean WSL prefix and passed the frozen3-page,24-cell,8-positive/4-absent document protocol; four extraction/retrieval artifacts exactly match Mac output. Designed born-digital Latin fixture with explicit table geometry; no OCR, inferred layout, general semantic retrieval or broad upstream corpus qualification.

highlights.title: Native WSL memory backup and restore
highlights.body: Official Linux ai-memory2.3.2 passed65 synthetic native checks across exact scope, Unicode/reserved paths, restart, upstream HTTP backup and native restore; four owned processes exited0. Isolated fresh synthetic store and39 MCP tool calls; not production activation, native-client integration or prior-version migration.

Compare fixed conceptual queries and cross-file impact tasks with lexical baseline; retain existing native services and avoid managed Docker duplicates.
